assets.prompt: A daylight phone photograph of a natural canvas volunteer's apron folded and laid on a weathered wooden picnic table. Screen-printed on the apron in ONE dark green ink (meadow green / cedar ink, about #23301F) is the market's COMPOUND LOCKUP mark: a cedar bough / branch across the top, an arched wordmark 'CEDAR COMMONS FARMERS MARKET' curving beneath it, the whole thing enclosed inside a thin circular RING RULE. Reproduce these traps exactly: (1) the coarse canvas WEAVE breaks the printed ink at stroke level, so every line is textured and slightly broken, not solid; (2) a FOLD in the apron runs across the LOWER THIRD of the ring, kinking and interrupting the ring rule and the bottom of the wordmark; (3) the ring is a genuine closed circle with an open interior. Single-ink faded screen print, worn, casual snapshot, slight angle, daylight.
assets.defect_engineered: compound lockup where a single compound selection returns the ring and arched wordmark but drops the cedar bough; a background removal on the ring hands back a solid opaque disc because the enclosed interior cannot be punched; coarse-canvas broken ink at stroke level; a fold distorting the lower third of the ring

assets.prompt: A phone photograph of a BLANK white coroplast (corrugated plastic) yard sign mounted on a thin galvanised wire H-stake, pushed into WET GREY GRAVEL beside a parking approach, shot roughly straight on for scale on an overcast day. Reproduce these traps exactly: (1) the sign LEANS a few degrees in the gravel (not upright); (2) the sign's LOWER EDGE and the thin WIRE STAKE sit at almost exactly the same grey value as the wet gravel behind them, so the base of the sign and the stake nearly disappear into the gravel. assets.content:
LAYOUT SPEC for cedar_commons_plate_card.pdf — render as a genuine press PDF from a full layout engine with embedded font subsets (NOT a thin hand-authored PDF). One card per page, trim 6 x 6 inches square. NO bleed, no crop marks. This is the sign shop's own stall-plate artwork from two seasons ago that they reprint from.

STRUCTURE: two visible elements.
  - STALL NUMBER block: a very large numeral, top two-thirds of the card, centred (sample value '12').
  - VENDOR NAME line: a single line of text in the bottom third (sample value 'Green Mountain Produce').

CRITICAL TRAP (author exactly): the VENDOR NAME sits in a FIXED-MEASURE text frame that does NOT auto-size and does NOT allow overset to reflow — set the frame to a fixed width spanning most of the card and a single line height, with overflow simply CLIPPED at the frame edge (no shrink-to-fit, no wrap to a second line). So a vendor name longer than the frame will be truncated at the frame edge and simply stop rendering, while the page still renders and the page count still matches.

Field labels the merge targets: STALL_NUMBER, VENDOR_NAME. Colours: cedar-ink (#23301F) and meadow-green (#3F7D44) on sign-white (#FBFAF5). Heavy bold slab/grotesque numerals and name, high contrast, made to be read at arm's length. No bleed (and none can be added later).
assets.defect_engineered: the vendor-name frame is a fixed measure that does not spill — a long name is truncated at trim while the merge reports success and the page count still matches the roster; the card carries no bleed and none can be introduced from a PDF-derived template

  A regular sheet, maybe 11 x 17, list of what is where by zone.
